title: Titlebar mark sits small and off-centre; the back chip fills on hover

reason: Fabio reported both defects live; causes measured off the repo, fixes are CSS in three files

note: both defects built; the hover fix was proven red against the pre-fix CSS

MPI-845 BUILT, both defects. (1) THE TITLEBAR MARK: index.html now loads assets/mascot/studio/logo.webp and .titlebar-logo-img is height:14px/width:auto instead of a square 16px box. Cause was measured, not guessed - logo.png is a 256x256 canvas holding 254x174 of art (44px padding above, 38 below), so a 16px square box rendered the robot 15.88 x 10.88 and was a third empty. The webp is the SAME artwork already cropped to zero padding (128x86, proven by overlay), already shipped, already used by MpiPromptBox. Measured live through playwright-cli off a static page, never :3000: before 16x16 box / 15.88x10.88 art, after 20.83x14 box / 20.83x14 art, and the image and text boxes centre at y=16.00 in BOTH - the boxes were never the problem, the art inside one of them was. DELIBERATELY NOT DONE: Russo One's caps sit 0.32px above the centre of their 12px line box (fontTools: upm 1000, hhea 926/-279, sCapHeight 700), so a box-centred mark still reads a third of a pixel low; a sub-pixel margin is unjudgeable and the dominant error is gone, so that waits for Fabio's eye. (2) THE BACK CHIP'S HOVER FILL: one rule in MpiProjectName.css at (0,4,0) covering both .mpi-project-name__back and .mpi-project-name__segment--link, which had the identical defect and was only invisible because nobody hovers the breadcrumb. Root cause was a SPECIFICITY LOSS, not a missing rule - the component's `background: none` is (0,1,0) and MpiButton's .mpi-btn--ghost:hover:not(:disabled) fills --surface-2 at (0,3,0). Flows and Record were always clean because they are ICON buttons matching .mpi-btn.mpi-ibtn.mpi-btn--ghost:hover, which pins background:transparent on purpose. MpiButton is NOT changed: a text ghost filling on hover is right everywhere else. tests/project-name-chip-hover.test.cjs 4/4, and it RESOLVES THE CASCADE rather than grepping - a text scan passes on the broken code because `background: none` is still sitting there losing. PROVEN RED on the pre-fix CSS (both chip cases failed naming `.mpi-btn--ghost:hover:not(:disabled)`; the two guard cases stayed green) and the file restored byte-identical. npm test 1545 tests, 1543 pass / 1 skipped / 1 FAIL, and the failure is NOT this card: tests/agent-no-delete.test.cjs rejects POST /connector/cancel, which HEAD's services/agentTools.mjs does not contain at all (0 hits vs 2 in the working copy) - a live peer added the route without extending the allowlist, and agentTools.mjs carries NO claim record. NOT VERIFIED BY FABIO - both defects were reported by eye and both need his, at his own resolution.
third defect folded in: MPI-822's min-height floor clamped FIVE call sites, not one

MPI-845 grew a THIRD defect and it was the interesting one. Fabio: the X on the reference-image chips renders as a tall rectangle. Cause is NOT a cascade loss like defect 2 - it is ddd813da (MPI-822, 'one height per control size, app-wide') adding min-height: var(--control-h-sm) = 34px to .mpi-btn--sm. A SIZE FLOOR CLAMPS THE USED HEIGHT AFTER THE CASCADE RESOLVES, so the remove pill's height:16px could not win at ANY specificity; the X rendered 16x34. MPI-822's own comment reasoned 'icon buttons are unchanged, text buttons grow to meet them - nothing shrinks', which held for every call site taking the default height and was FALSE for every one that had deliberately shrunk below it. THERE WERE FIVE, NOT ONE: MpiPromptBox .mpi-prompt-box-media-strip__remove (16->34), MpiQueuePanel .mpi-queue-panel__action (26->34) and .mpi-queue-panel__icon-btn (28->34), MpiModelManager .mpi-detail__close (28->34), MpiMemoryMonitor .mpi-mem-monitor__btn-wrap .mpi-ibtn (30->34). All five fixed in one pass per the shared-primitive rule, each with min-height: 0 beside its existing height so the floor is RELEASED rather than the number restated. MpiButton.css NOT touched - the floor is correct and still doing its job for every other button. Measured off a static page carrying the real 01_base/MpiButton/MpiPromptBox CSS through playwright-cli: before 16x34, after 16x16. Worth recording: the FIRST attempt at the before column measured 16x16 and was wrong, because the simulated floor was written at (0,2,0) and lost to the real rule's (0,3,0) - the same specificity trap defect 2 is about, met while trying to demonstrate a different bug. GUARD: tests/button-size-floor.test.cjs, 2/2, walks every stylesheet and fails any rule whose SUBJECT is a button (not an icon/img/spinner child) asking for a height under its size token without releasing min-height; its second case pins MPI-822's floor still being present, so deleting the floor cannot make the first case pass vacuously. PROVEN RED with all five fixes reverted - it named all five with files and numbers - then all four files restored byte-identical. npm test 1549 tests, 1548 pass / 1 skipped / 0 FAIL: the agent-no-delete failure reported earlier this session is gone, the peer extended their own allowlist. STILL AWAITING FABIO'S EYE on all three.
All three chrome defects are built, committed and test-guarded. Only Fabio's eye is left: reload and check the titlebar mark, the GALLERY/PROJECTS chip on hover, and the X on a reference-image chip.
